public_context.environment_introduction:
# Environment Information

## Brief Introduction:  
This is a software environment designed for handling and tracking billing disputes within an organization or service provider.  
It maintains detailed records of billing items, dispute submissions, unique identifiers for tracking, and resolution statuses.  
Operators can update the resolution state of disputes, ensuring transparent and accountable management of financial discrepancies and resolutions.

## Environment Rules / Constraints:  
- A dispute must be linked to a valid billing item.
- Resolution status can only be updated by authorized operators.
- Resolution status values must be from an allowed set (e.g., "accepted", "rejected", "pending", etc.).
- Each resolution action must be timestamped and record the responsible operator.
public_context.task:
Triage and close all currently pending disputes by assigning a resolver, updating their resolution statuses with clear details, and timestamping the actions.

Scope:
- Disputes to process: dsp-c913f70a-0a5b-44c7 (BILL-1001) and dsp-4cdaf638-affe-4b3d (BILL-1002).
- Use authorized resolver: Harriet Young (operator_id: op-harriet-young).

Required actions:
1) For dispute dsp-c913f70a-0a5b-44c7 (BILL-1001, reason: “The subscription fee was billed twice for March.”):
   - Validate the dispute’s link to its billing item.
   - Confirm the allowed resolution status values, then set resolution_status to “accepted”.
   - Add resolution_details explaining: “Duplicate March subscription charge reversed; credit of $249.99 applied to account; upcoming invoice corrected.”
   - Assign resolver_id to op-harriet-young.
   - Record the resolution timestamp.

2) For dispute dsp-4cdaf638-affe-4b3d (BILL-1002, reason: “Incorrect amount charged for hardware replacement.”):
   - Validate the dispute’s link to its billing item and review existing disputes for BILL-1002 (note: dsp-f9a4e458-e1fe-43ab is already resolved with a partial refund for missed service).
   - Confirm the allowed resolution status values, then set resolution_status to “rejected”.
   - Add resolution_details indicating: the dispute reason mismatches the billed item (BILL-1002 is a hardware maintenance fee for $87.50), reference the prior resolved dispute dsp-f9a4e458-e1fe-43ab on the same item, and instruct the submitter to open a new dispute referencing the correct billing item if hardware replacement charges are in question.
   - Assign resolver_id to op-harriet-young.
   - Record the resolution timestamp.

Constraints:
- Only use allowed resolution_status values.
- Ensure operator authorization is respected and each update is properly timestamped.
- Do not modify any other disputes outside the two specified pending records.

function.description:

validate_dispute_billing_item_relation

function.description:
Update a dispute's resolution_status, set resolution_details, record resolver_id and timestamp.

Args:
    dispute_id (str): The unique ID of the dispute to resolve.
    resolution_status (str): The new status for the dispute (must be allowed).
    resolution_details (str): Details of the resolution decision.
    resolver_id (str): The operator ID who is performing the resolution.

Returns:
    dict:
        success: True/False
        message: On success, brief description.
        error: On failure, reason for failure.

Constraints:
    - Dispute must exist.
    - Operator must exist and be authorized (role != "viewer"/"guest").
    - Resolution_status must be from allowed set.
    - Must record the operator (resolver_id) and current timestamp in 'resolution_date'.
function.name: resolve_dispute

function.description:
Change the resolution_status value of a dispute after verifying:
- Dispute exists and is linked to a valid billing item.
- Operator exists and is authorized to update dispute statuses.
- The new resolution_status is within the allowed status values.
Automatically updates resolver_id and resolution_date with the operator and current timestamp.

Args:
    dispute_id (str): The dispute to update.
    new_status (str): The status to assign (must be allowed).
    operator_id (str): The operator making the change.

Returns:
    dict:
        { "success": True, "message": "Resolution status updated successfully." }
        or
        { "success": False, "error": str }
function.name: update_dispute_resolution_status

function.description:
Attach or update the resolution_details text field in the given dispute record.

Args:
    dispute_id (str): Unique dispute identifier.
    resolution_details (str): Text to be attached or set as resolution details.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Resolution details updated for dispute <dispute_id>"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Dispute does not exist"
    }

Constraints:
    - The dispute record must exist.
    - Only the resolution_details field is modified (no change to status/timestamps/resolver).
function.name: add_dispute_resolution_details

function.description:
Create a new dispute linked to a billing item.

Args:
    billing_item_id (str): The billing item to dispute (must exist).
    dispute_reason (str): Reason for the dispute (non-empty).
    submitter_id (str): The user/customer submitting the dispute (non-empty).
    submit_date (str, optional): Submission timestamp, ISO format; if None, uses current time.

Returns:
    dict: 
        Success: {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Dispute created",
            "dispute_id": <new_id>
        }
        Failure: {
            "success": False,
            "error": "reason"
        }

Constraints:
    - Billing item must exist.
    - Dispute reason and submitter ID must be provided.
    - Dispute ID is auto-generated and unique.
    - Resolution status initialized to 'pending', details blank, no resolver/date.
function.name: add_dispute

function.description:
Remove (delete) or archive a dispute record corresponding to the provided dispute ID.

Args:
    dispute_id (str): The unique identifier of the dispute to remove.

Returns:
    dict: On success:
        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Dispute <dispute_id> deleted."
        }
        On failure:
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": "Dispute does not exist."
        }

Constraints:
    - The dispute must exist in the system.
function.name: delete_dispute

function.description:
Set or update the responsible operator (resolver_id) for the specified dispute.

Args:
    dispute_id (str): The unique identifier of the dispute.
    operator_id (str): The unique identifier of the operator to assign.

Returns:
    dict:
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Resolver updated for dispute <dispute_id>"
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # Reason for failure
            }

Constraints:
    - The dispute_id must exist in self.disputes.
    - The operator_id must exist in self.operators.
    - Only sets or updates resolver_id; does not change resolution status/timestamps.
function.name: assign_dispute_resolver

function.description:
Record or update the resolution_date field of a dispute when its resolution status changes.

Args:
    dispute_id (str): The unique identifier of the dispute to update.
    resolution_date (str): The timestamp to record (expected ISO8601 string or similar).

Returns:
    dict: On success:
        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Resolution timestamp updated for dispute <dispute_id>."
        }
    Or on failure:
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": "Dispute not found."
        }

Constraints:
    - The dispute specified by dispute_id must exist.
    - Only the resolution_date field is updated in this operation.
function.name: timestamp_dispute_resolution

    resolution_status (str): The new status for the dispute (must be allowed).
    resolution_details (str): Details of the resolution decision.
    resolver_id (str): The operator ID who is performing the resolution.

Returns:
    dict:
        success: True/False
        message: On success, brief description.
        error: On failure, reason for failure.

Constraints:
    - Dispute must exist.
    - Operator must exist and be authorized (role != "viewer"/"guest").
    - Resolution_status must be from allowed set.
    - Must record the operator (resolver_id) and current timestamp in 'resolution_date'.
function.name: resolve_dispute

function.description:
Change the resolution_status value of a dispute after verifying:
- Dispute exists and is linked to a valid billing item.
- Operator exists and is authorized to update dispute statuses.
- The new resolution_status is within the allowed status values.
Automatically updates resolver_id and resolution_date with the operator and current timestamp.

Args:
    dispute_id (str): The dispute to update.
    new_status (str): The status to assign (must be allowed).
    operator_id (str): The operator making the change.

Returns:
    dict:
        { "success": True, "message": "Resolution status updated successfully." }
        or
        { "success": False, "error": str }
function.name: update_dispute_resolution_status

function.description:
Attach or update the resolution_details text field in the given dispute record.

Args:
    dispute_id (str): Unique dispute identifier.
    resolution_details (str): Text to be attached or set as resolution details.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Resolution details updated for dispute <dispute_id>"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Dispute does not exist"
    }

Constraints:
    - The dispute record must exist.
    - Only the resolution_details field is modified (no change to status/timestamps/resolver).
function.name: add_dispute_resolution_details

function.description:
Create a new dispute linked to a billing item.

Args:
    billing_item_id (str): The billing item to dispute (must exist).
    dispute_reason (str): Reason for the dispute (non-empty).
    submitter_id (str): The user/customer submitting the dispute (non-empty).
    submit_date (str, optional): Submission timestamp, ISO format; if None, uses current time.

Returns:
    dict: 
        Success: {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Dispute created",
            "dispute_id": <new_id>
        }
        Failure: {
            "success": False,
            "error": "reason"
        }

Constraints:
    - Billing item must exist.
    - Dispute reason and submitter ID must be provided.
    - Dispute ID is auto-generated and unique.
    - Resolution status initialized to 'pending', details blank, no resolver/date.
function.name: add_dispute

function.description:
Remove (delete) or archive a dispute record corresponding to the provided dispute ID.

    dispute_id (str): The unique identifier of the dispute to remove.

Returns:

        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Dispute <dispute_id> deleted."
        }
        On failure:
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": "Dispute does not exist."
        }

Constraints:
    - The dispute must exist in the system.
function.name: delete_dispute

function.description:
Set or update the responsible operator (resolver_id) for the specified dispute.

Args:
    dispute_id (str): The unique identifier of the dispute.
    operator_id (str): The unique identifier of the operator to assign.

Returns:
    dict:
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Resolver updated for dispute <dispute_id>"
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # Reason for failure
            }

Constraints:
    - The dispute_id must exist in self.disputes.
    - The operator_id must exist in self.operators.
    - Only sets or updates resolver_id; does not change resolution status/timestamps.

function.description:
Record or update the resolution_date field of a dispute when its resolution status changes.

Returns:

        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Resolution timestamp updated for dispute <dispute_id>."
        }
    Or on failure:
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": "Dispute not found."
        }

Constraints:
    - The dispute specified by dispute_id must exist.
    - Only the resolution_date field is updated in this operation.
